body.text:
new round!

by the power of axum middleware we have a policy which handles the cache generically for routes in a pretty sane way

frontend gets split out from lib.rs like the last round

in the second commit, several places get `no-store` cache headers applied where we should probably be using them

third commit uses the vite manifest to determine what hashed assets can be statically cached 

fourth commit is some wizardry -- from what I can tell the ref appview has cache headers for conditional requests (e.g. allowing 304 response) but the ref pds appears to strip them. we dont have to do that!!

we want to be a bit careful about proxying cache headers from appviews in case they are using them incorrectly, but it seems to me that regular social-app users with tranquil-pds on bsky appview may be able to trivially get a 304 for e.g. a getProfile request?

fifth commit expands a bit into xrpc cache headers. using cids we can generate an etag for these requests!
